title: Charo Santos, Annette Gozon amuse with collab that ‘no one expected’

blocks.text: Charo Santos-Concio and Annette Gozon-Valdes amused social media users after joining the viral “All I See Is Dollar Signs” trend. Santos took to Instagram on Saturday, Oct. 24, to share a TikTok video of herself and Gozon-Valdes participating in the trend. The duo began the trend by clicking their heels together then gracefully grooving to the beat. “The collab no one expected!” Santos wrote in the caption.
